name: Miami International Holdings, Inc.
summary: Miami International Holdings, Inc., through its subsidiaries, builds and operates various financial marketplaces in the United States. It operates through Options, Equities, and International segments. The company's markets include options through MIAX Options, MIAX Pearl, MIAX Emerald, and MIAX Sapphire; U.S. equities through MIAX Pearl Equities; U.S. futures and options on futures through MIAX Futures; and international listings through BSX and TISE.
